about: The hand grade of reference-goal.md: every element present, with the line each grade rests on. The goal is ready.

grades.quote: THE FINISH LINE is the printer's signed proof of the complete guide, held by the print shop and not by this project.
The reader is a walker who has never used a field guide, not the chairman who commissioned it.
the brief is a subset of the standard, not the whole of it
Pages drafted, birds researched and words written are not progress, and this project is not graded on them.
a person who has not seen the entry is shown three photographs and must name the bird from the entry alone
A bias, not a rule: prefer drawings to photographs for the plates
The quality bar is that no entry sends a reader to the wrong bird, because a guide that is wrong once is not trusted again. The editor owns that bar
He will not write entries, choose plates or check facts; those are the project's.
Spend carefully until the first ten entries pass the naming test, because the method is unproven until then.
If the proof cannot be signed, what is owed instead is every entry that passed its naming test, bound as a shorter guide
